metaShifts.theme: Sustain and Farming Efficiency Further Erosion
metaShifts.description: Building on 7.38's lifesteal standardization, this patch continues the assault on sustain with Vampiric facet nerfs (-4% lifesteal, -4% spell lifesteal at max), Essence Ring duration cut (15s→10s), and Glimmer Cape mobility reduction (40→20 MS). Combined with reduced Tormentor gold (250→175), the meta continues moving away from sustain-based farming toward aggressive early game.

After 7.38's Intelligence rehabilitation, this patch applies surgical nerfs to prevent overcorrection. Storm Spirit (-0.2 int gain), Leshrac (mana costs +30 at max), Zeus (-4 base damage), and Invoker (Forge Spirit range adjustments) all receive targeted nerfs. The meta is fine-tuning Intelligence cores rather than dismantling them.

Systematic nerfs to Orchid (-5 attack speed, -0.25 mana regen) and Bloodthorn (-5 attack speed, -0.25 mana regen) target the spell-based right-click hybrid builds that emerged post-7.38. This specifically impacts heroes who bridge spell casting and physical damage, forcing clearer build path decisions.

Major nerfs to high-impact neutrals: Fallen Sky cooldown nearly doubled (15s→25s), Ninja Gear mana cost added (0→100), Serrated Shiv damage reduced (10%→8%), and Gale Guard barrier halved (400→250). This continues 7.38's trend of making neutrals more strategic choices rather than game-changing power spikes.

Targeted nerfs to dominant support tools: Glimmer Cape mobility and mana efficiency gutted, Abaddon's entire kit nerfed (Mist Coil -35 heal, Shield duration -3s, mana costs up), and Winter Wyvern ultimate cooldown increased (+15s at level 1). This addresses support power creep without destroying the role.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Windranger receives agility gain buff (+0.2) and Shackleshot duration increases, while Khanda gets significant buffs (cooldown 12s→10s, debuff duration 3s→4s). Her improved right-click scaling synergizes perfectly with Khanda's enhanced spell-to-physical damage conversion.

Lina's Shard now converts 100% of Laguna Blade damage (up from 75%), while Intelligence cores face systematic nerfs. This makes Lina's pure damage nuke even more valuable in a meta where magical damage is being constrained.

Chen's Summon Convert abilities now scale with Holy Persuasion levels, creating exponential power scaling. In a meta where neutral items are nerfed and farming is less efficient, Chen's army becomes relatively stronger throughout the game.

synergisticWinners.entity: Keeper of the Light + Spirit Form Buffs
synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: KOTL receives comprehensive Spirit Form buffs (cooldown reduction, duration increase, heal standardization to 70%) while other Intelligence cores get nerfed. This positions him as a premier Intelligence core in the post-correction landscape.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: Storm Spirit loses 0.2 intelligence gain while his core items Orchid and Bloodthorn both receive attack speed and mana regen nerfs. This double-hit severely impacts his mid-game power spike and late-game scaling potential.

Abaddon faces comprehensive nerfs across his entire kit while Glimmer Cape, a core support item for his playstyle, loses 50% of its movement speed bonus and costs 35 more mana. This destroys the mobile support Abaddon build.

Lifestealer receives base agility nerf and Feast HP reduction while Vampiric facet gets nerfed across all tiers. This continues the systematic dismantling of lifesteal-based sustain that began in 7.38.

Winter Wyvern's ultimate receives massive cooldown nerfs (+15s early) while high-impact neutrals like Fallen Sky and Ninja Gear that enabled her playmaking get severely nerfed. Her teamfight windows become much more limited.

Carry.explanation: Receives Juxtapose proc chance increase (8%→9%) while other carries face systematic nerfs. In a meta where farming efficiency is reduced and sustain is nerfed, PL's ability to create chaos and pressure multiple lanes becomes more valuable.

Mid.explanation: Aghanim's Shard Laguna Blade conversion buffed to 100% while other Intelligence mids get nerfed. Her pure damage nuke becomes premium in a constrained magical damage meta, and she avoids the systematic Intelligence core nerfs.

Comprehensive Spirit Form buffs (cooldown reduction, duration increase) while other Intelligence cores face nerfs. Positioned as the premier Intelligence mid in the post-correction landscape with enhanced farming and teamfight presence.

Offlane.explanation: Belligerent duration on respawn increased (30s→45s) and receives talent rework toward Thunder Clap duration. In a meta focused on early aggression over farming, his teamfight control and respawn advantage become more impactful.

SoftSupport.explanation: Agility gain buff (+0.2) and Shackleshot duration increases while maintaining support viability. Her improved scaling allows her to transition better into late game when played as position 4, especially with Khanda synergy.

HardSupport.explanation: Summon Convert abilities now scale with Holy Persuasion, creating exponential army power. In a meta where neutral items are nerfed and individual power spikes are reduced, Chen's controlled army becomes relatively stronger.

Carry.explanation: Base agility nerf (-4), Feast HP per kill reduced (15→10), and Vampiric facet nerfs continue the systematic dismantling of lifesteal-based carries. His sustain-focused playstyle is directly countered by the meta direction.

Fervor Shard no longer procs on buildings/wards, removing his tower-taking advantage. In a meta moving toward early aggression, losing his objective control power significantly reduces his carry impact.

Mid.explanation: Intelligence gain nerf (-0.2) combined with Orchid/Bloodthorn nerfs destroys his scaling. His core item build path becomes significantly weaker while his attribute growth is reduced, creating a double-hit to his power curve.

Base damage reduced by 4 and Lightning Bolt sight radius nerfed (750→500). His laning becomes weaker while his map control utility is reduced, making him less effective in both early and mid game phases.

Offlane.explanation: Anchor Smash damage reduction nerfed significantly (60%→40% at max) and Dead in the Water damage halved (200→100) with increased mana cost. His teamfight control and laning presence are both severely diminished.
Grow armor bonus nearly halved (24→15 at max level). His late-game tankiness is severely reduced, making him much more vulnerable in teamfights where he needs to be in melee range.

SoftSupport.explanation: Winter's Curse cooldown increased massively (+15s at level 1) and loses physical immunity against WW. Her teamfight impact windows become much more limited while her ultimate becomes less reliable for saving allies.

HardSupport.explanation: Comprehensive nerfs across entire kit: Mist Coil heal reduced by 35, Aphotic Shield duration -3s, mana costs increased, and base mana regen removed. His sustain-based support style is systematically dismantled.
Poison Touch duration significantly reduced early game (5s→3.5s at level 1) while Lotus pickup restriction affects his utility. His early game harassment and control are notably weakened.
